note: Rebuild the staged port from the re-cut patch. The port's mid-frame counters now print on the exit a served run takes (the stream-closed one) and not only inside the --frames branch, and the patch id moved 043fc12 -> f2cd1f27, so every port run stamps OUT OF SYNC until this lands. No arguments - rebuild.sh defaults to /opt/neuralscreen/port, which is what NS_WORKER_CMD points at. Two lines to read: the stamp, which must name f2cd1f27 and say 'in sync' (NOT 91c8a0c768c0, which is what the box is carrying now), and 16 shader modules / 78 PTX kernels. Nothing else in the patch changed - this build's only new code is five lines in serve.cpp's exit paths - so a module count other than 16/78, or a shader that fails to compile, means something else moved.
